title: Chapter 237 Alchemy Meeting
content:
Chapter 237 Alchemy Meeting

Rumors are rumors after all.

They don’t know each other, but how could mentor Wang Hao admit his mistake?

For a moment, everyone present immediately looked at Xiao Yin in front of him with fanatical eyes.

At the same time, the entire inner courtyard learned about the news and rushed towards the square.

Standing beside Xiao Yin, Xiao Luo was filled with blood.

Hahaha, see, this is his clan sister!

Xiao Yin, who instantly became the star of the moon, was still expressionless. She had become accustomed to these things millions of years ago.

This is the daily life of a genius and monster.

Wherever you go, you are extremely dazzling.

However, thinking that Lu Xue is still by his side, Xiao Yin quickly asked in a low voice: "Lu Xue, are you going back? If you go back, we will leave now."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"Then let's go."

Although he was not the main target, Lu Xue was still a little uncomfortable when she looked at the hot gazes of everyone around her.

Seeing this, Xiao Yin did not hesitate at all and grabbed Lu Xue and Xiao Luo with both hands.

"Mr. Wang, say goodbye."

The next moment, the three of them disappeared directly.

Looking at the disappearance of Xiao Yin and the other two, everyone's passion began to gradually weaken.

But there is no doubt that the two words Xiao Yin will resound throughout the Tiandi Academy again.

Even so, the entire fairyland!

Of course, the news that Qin Feng was ranked 52nd in the martial arts list also ignited a lot of heat in the inner courtyard.

For a moment, the number of students who were taking the rankings in the entire inner courtyard suddenly began to increase.

As more people make the rankings, the pressure on the martial arts list becomes even greater.

In just a few days, Qin Feng's ranking of 52 was directly dropped to 56, which shows how much pressure it was.

On this day, Zhuyun Peak.

In a training room, Lu Xue is practicing day after day.

The surroundings are covered with a kind of dark purple crystal, which is several times more abundant than the immortal crystal.

Under the influence of this crystal, the immortal energy in the entire cultivation room was extremely rich.

Click—

As a clear sound came from Lu Xue's body.

The next moment, a breath of the Immortal Lord Realm slowly overflowed from Lu Xue's body.

"call."

After taking a deep breath, Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes.

With a buzzing sound, Lu Xue clenched her fists, feeling the power of the Immortal Lord Realm, but there was no joy on Lu Xue's face.

After all, being in a place where almost all geniuses and monsters is still not enough to just break through to the Immortal Lord realm.

"It still needs to continue working hard."

Lu Xue sighed and then prepared to continue practicing.

To be honest, Lu Xue hasn't practiced so seriously for a long time.

If Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun saw Lu Xue now, they would not know how happy they would be.

This is also attributed to the environment Lu Xue is in.

Here, they are basically young people of the same age as Lu Xue. Everyone's crazy competition has also successfully led Lu Xue.

Because she knew that when she came out, she represented the deserted city.

If I act too badly, wouldn’t it be a shame for Huangcheng and my parents?

That was definitely not what Lu Xue wanted to see.

Closed his eyes, and a stream of fairy aura around him began to surge into Lu Xue's body again.

And at this moment, a sound suddenly came into the cultivation room.

"Lu Xue, someone is looking for you."

Hearing the sound, Lu Xue immediately opened her eyes.

"Someone is looking for me?"

In this academy, who else can I come to me except Xiao Yin and Xiao Luo?

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue still chose to go out and take a look.

Zhuyun Peak Somewhere.

"Alchemy? Brother Qin, I don't seem to be very good at this."

"Hey, it seems like someone will. Let's go and have a look. The key is, don't you want to know a few alchemists?"

Qin Feng looked at Xiao Luo with a smirk and said.

When Xiao Luo heard this, he was immediately moved.

Alchemist.

That's really rare.

The profession of alchemist is not common in the fairyland. Although people often take some elixirs on weekdays, they basically get elixirs such as healing.

For example, there are few people who can eat higher-level pills that can increase cultivation speed or increase combat power in battle.

If so, it is also used at critical moments.

For example, the recovery pill that Wang Hao took to Qin Feng before was that kind of high-level pill.

It can quickly recover from injuries in an instant. If this pill is taken in battle, you can imagine how effective it will be.

As an ancient force in the Immortal Realm, the Xiao clan once had his own alchemist.

Unfortunately, as the Xiao clan declined, the Xiao clan's alchemist also disappeared from the clan.

Just as Xiao Luo was hesitating, Lu Xue's figure appeared in the distance.

"You guys look for me?"

Before Xiao Luo could speak, Qin Feng, who was beside him, came forward with a smirk and said, "Miss Lu, I'm looking for you."

Now, Qin Feng has learned Lu Xue’s name.

Even more, under the reminder of his mentor Wang Hao, more than Lu Xue’s friendship was with each other.

So Qin Feng came to find Lu Xue.

Of course, even if Wang Hao doesn’t say it, Qin Feng will come.

Qin Feng will never forget the last time that one million immortal crystals happened.

Looking at Qin Feng in front of him, Lu Xue asked in confusion: "Look for me?"

Immediately, Qin Feng told Lu Xue about the alchemy meeting held by the inner courtyard.

In the Tiandi Academy, there are students who specialize in learning alchemy.

Among the nine peaks in the inner courtyard, Yidan Peak is one of them.

Jordanyang, the leader of the Alchemy Peak Peak, is the most famous alchemist in the entire fairy world. No one has surpassed his elixir skills so far.

It is no exaggeration to say that if the Tiandi Academy had no Jordanyang, the status of the Academy would be three feet below the Immortal Realm.

The alchemy meeting that Qin Feng mentioned was hosted by Danfeng himself and authorized by instructor Jordanyang.

Of course, the entire academy, those who know how to refine alchemy are basically from the Alchemy Peak, so the alchemy meeting, speaking of it, is an exchange meeting.

Give the rest of the peaks or students a chance to recognize the alchemist.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked thoughtful.

If you have any pills, you must have taken them, and there are quite a few.

All of them were given to her by Lu Daosheng.

"By the way, where did my dad get so many elixirs? Could it be that my dad knows some very powerful alchemist?"

Lu Xue was confused, and in the end, Lu Xue agreed to go to the alchemy meeting with Qin Feng.

Although I don’t lack pills, I can still take a look.

As for Xiao Luo, Lu Xue has gone, so Xiao Luo is no exception.

Soon, the three of them came to the alchemy party.

The Alchemy Peak is very close here.

The entire alchemy meeting has not yet begun, but it has been overcrowded.

Not only students, but some teachers also came here to watch.

Alchemy lesson.

All are alchemists.

Who can guarantee that among these young alchemists will be a powerful alchemy like Master Qiao Jordanyang in the future?
